description.de: Während des Kampfes darf kein Versuch unternommen werden, Gegnern BP zu entziehen.
description.en: Do not attempt to reduce your enemies' MP for the duration of the combat.
description.es: No quites PM a los adversarios mientras dure el combate.
description.fr: Ne pas tenter de retirer de PM aux adversaires pendant toute la durée du combat.
description.pt: Não tentar retirar PM dos adversários durante todo o combate.
